title: Resident Handbook — Amenity and Service Fees Under the Independent Living Residency Agreement
content:
Scheduled service and amenity fees under the Independent Living Residency Agreement follow the figures of the resident's apartment type and are posted under their fee code.

## Pets

A pet is registered only within the maximum registered pets and, for a dog, the maximum adult weight of the apartment type. Registration posts the one-time pet fee per pet, and the monthly pet fee per pet is charged for each billing month in which the pet is registered, without proration.

## Storage and covered parking

A storage unit is charged at the monthly storage rent per billing month only where a storage unit is not included in the apartment type or a second unit is rented. Covered parking is charged at the monthly covered parking rent per billing month for each space beyond the covered spaces included in the apartment type.

## Guest suite

Guest suite nights are posted one booking at a time, of no more than the longest single booking of the apartment type in nights. Nights are first drawn from the included guest suite nights of the calendar year and posted at 0.00, and every further night is charged at the guest suite nightly rate. The nights already used are counted over the calendar year (January 1 to December 31) containing the night being booked, by service date, summing the nights on guest suite night entries of the residency whether charged or posted at 0.00 as included nights.

Hypothetical example: with 4 included nights a year, 3 nights already used this calendar year and a new 3-night booking, the first night is posted at 0.00 and the other 2 nights are charged at the nightly rate.

## Replacements and lockouts

Key fob and pendant replacements are charged per item at the key fob replacement fee and the pendant replacement fee. An after-hours lockout call is posted at 0.00 while the number of after-hours lockout calls on the residency within the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the date of the call (by service date, counting calls charged and calls posted at 0.00), counted before the call, is below the included lockout calls of the apartment type, and at the lockout fee otherwise.

| Lockout calls already in the rolling 365 days before this call (2 included) | This call |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | Posted at 0.00 |
| 2 or more | Charged at the lockout fee |

## Move-out cleaning and transfers

The clause under which the carpet cleaning fee of the apartment type was charged once when the apartment is vacated is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the move-out carpet cleaning fee. An apartment transfer fee equal to the transfer fee of the apartment type moved into is charged once per transfer.

## Status and corrections

Service fees may be posted while the residency is in active, notice given or vacated status. A service fee posted in error is reversed only through a billing error credit referencing that fee entry.

superseded_clauses: The carpet_cleaning fee of the apartment type is charged once when the apartment is vacated
